title: Arcana Agent Target Registry
description: Authoritative registry for agent instruction files, skill registration behavior, and automatic configuration support.

targets.label: Claude Code
targets.summary: Arcana installs as the grm and arc plugins from the repository's own marketplace; the grm plugin's session-start hook keeps the engine checkout current and prints the routing context. Without the plugins, Arcana injects the Grimoire routing block and registers full skill folders. Grimoire skills register as full skill folders either way.

targets.label: Codex / ChatGPT CLI
targets.summary: Arcana injects the Grimoire routing block and registers pointer-only SKILL.md folders in ~/.agents/skills; Codex also reads ~/.codex/skills, so registration keeps managed skills out of it.
limitations: Registered skill directories contain SKILL.md only.

targets.label: ChatGPT (hosted)
targets.summary: Paste the Grimoire routing block manually into Custom Instructions.
limitations: No local skill directory is available to Arcana.

targets.label: GitHub Copilot
targets.summary: Add the Grimoire routing block manually to repository instructions when useful.
limitations: Project-level files require explicit user approval before editing.
Length limits may require trimming to the core routing sections.

targets.label: Cursor
targets.summary: Add the Grimoire routing block manually to Cursor rules.
limitations: Arcana does not manage Cursor rule files automatically.
